title: C-C fix round: async dispatch, stamp-after-effect with exception handling, safe notify (review T-0054)
spec:
Why: security review T-0054 on daemon commit 93a1b64 (full text: /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/.orchestrator/tasks/T-0054.json). HIGH 1 (daemon.py:~64): dispatch() calls executor.start inline; executor._run blocks on subprocess.run up to 900-1800 s, so one dispatch stalls the whole tick and every other stage. HIGH 2 (daemon.py:~88): gate() writes pipeline.gated_at before merge.merge / bus.create_task run, and neither gate() nor tick()/main() catch exceptions (git RuntimeError, missing worktree cwd) — a failure leaves the stage stamped and the task stuck. LOW (daemon.py:~102): notify() interpolates untrusted text (merge stderr, task titles) into an osascript -e literal; a quote breaks out and runs arbitrary local commands.

What (2 files: orchestrator/daemon.py, tests/test_daemon.py; this worktree branches from task/T-0050):
1. dispatch: run executor.start via the same spawn_async/thread helper the file uses for spec_review and review; stamp dispatched_at under the lock before starting the thread (so a second tick does not double-dispatch), and have the thread record `pipeline.dispatch_error` via bus.update if executor.start raises.
2. Every stage: claim the stamp under the lock (keeps idempotency), then run the side effect inside try/except Exception; on exception write `pipeline.<stage>_error = str(e)[:300]`, set the task held with hold_reason f"<stage> failed: <type>" and notify; tick() wraps each stage call in try/except so one bad task never stops the loop; main() catches exceptions per tick and keeps running. gate(): check the worktree path exists before running the gate; missing → held with hold_reason "worktree missing".
3. notify(msg): never interpolate into the AppleScript source. Pass the text as an argument: `osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'display notification (item 1 of argv) with title "orchestrator"' -e 'end run' -- <msg>` and truncate msg to 200 chars; stderr print unchanged. Add a test that notify() with a message containing a double quote and `" & do shell script "echo x` calls subprocess.run with the message only in argv (monkeypatch subprocess.run to capture).
4. tests/test_daemon.py: (a) dispatch does not block: monkeypatch executor.start with a function that sleeps 2 s and assert tick() returns in under 0.5 s and dispatched_at is set exactly once across two ticks; (b) gate side effect raising → task held with hold_reason starting "gate failed", gated_error recorded, tick() returns normally; (c) missing worktree → held "worktree missing"; (d) the notify argv test. Keep the five existing scenarios green.

Run `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests`. Commit: "daemon: async dispatch, per-stage exception handling with error stamps, argv-safe notify (review T-0054)" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests exits 0 with the four new daemon tests
tick() returns quickly while a dispatched executor is still running (test a)
a raising stage leaves the task held with a hold_reason and an error stamp, and tick() keeps going (tests b, c)
notify passes untrusted text only as an argv item, never inside the AppleScript source (test d)
git diff --stat limited to orchestrator/daemon.py and tests/test_daemon.py

## Summary

Fixed the three issues from security review T-0054 in `orchestrator/daemon.py`:

1. **Async dispatch** — `executor.start` now runs on a background thread (via a generalized `spawn_async(fn, *args)`), stamped `dispatched_at` under the lock first so a second tick can't double-dispatch. A raise is caught and recorded as `pipeline.dispatch_error`.
2. **Per-stage exception handling** — `dispatch()`'s spec_review branch, `gate()`'s merge/review-creation branch, and `merge_reviewed()`'s merge call are each wrapped in try/except; a failure holds the task with `hold_reason` and a `pipeline.<stage>_error` stamp instead of leaving it wedged. `gate()` also checks the worktree path exists before running tests-green (`hold_reason="worktree missing"`). `tick()` and `main()` catch exceptions per stage/tick so one bad task never stops the loop.
3. **argv-safe notify** — untrusted text (merge stderr, task titles) is now passed as an `osascript` argv item via an `on run argv` script, truncated to 200 chars, instead of being interpolated into the AppleScript source.

Files changed: `orchestrator/daemon.py`, `tests/test_daemon.py` (matches scope exactly, confirmed via `git diff --stat`).

Test output: `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` → 80 tests, all passing (no failures). `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` gate exits 0.

Committed on `task/T-0056` as `9cb2114`.
